name: Nomos
description: A spend mandate for Bitcoin Cash: BCH in a covenant that pays only within a daily limit and to allowed addresses. The chain refuses anything else.

resources.name: Live app
resources.description: Create a vault and pay under your mandate.

spender.name: Spender
spender.description: The vault owner or its agent. Pays within the mandate.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Owns the vault. Can withdraw it, and rescue it with the co-signer.

rescuer.name: Rescue co-signer
rescuer.description: Second key for emergency rescues, together with the owner.

funder.name: Funder
funder.description: Anyone adding BCH to a vault.

pay.name: Pay under mandate
pay.description: Pay $(<amountSatoshis>) satoshis from the vault. Allowed today: $(remainingToday) satoshis. Over the limit, the network refuses the transaction.

topUp.name: Top up the vault
topUp.description: Send $(<topUpSatoshis>) satoshis to the vault. Only the owner can merge top-ups into payments.

withdraw.name: Withdraw the vault
withdraw.description: Take the vault NFT and $(withdrawSatoshis) satoshis back. Owner only.

rescue.name: Emergency rescue
rescue.description: Sweep $(withdrawSatoshis) satoshis out of the vault, ignoring the daily limit. Needs the owner AND the rescue co-signer.

payTransaction.name: Paid under mandate
payTransaction.description: Paid $(<amountSatoshis>) satoshis. The vault now counts $(newSpentToday) satoshis spent today.

withdrawTransaction.name: Vault withdrawn
withdrawTransaction.description: The vault NFT and its BCH are back in your wallet.

rescueTransaction.name: Vault rescued
rescueTransaction.description: Swept the vault with the owner and rescue co-signer.

vaultPayInput.name: Nomos vault
vaultPayInput.description: The vault coin with its state NFT.

vaultWithdrawInput.name: Nomos vault
vaultWithdrawInput.description: The vault coin, going back to the owner.

vaultRescueInput.name: Nomos vault
vaultRescueInput.description: The vault coin, swept by owner + co-signer.

vaultAfterPayOutput.name: Nomos vault
vaultAfterPayOutput.description: The vault continues with $(newSpentToday) satoshis spent today.

vault.name: Nomos vault
vault.description: Pays only within the daily limit and allowlist; the network refuses anything else.

payee.name: Payee
payee.description: Who gets paid. Must be allowlisted if the vault has an allowlist.

ownerReturn.name: Your wallet
ownerReturn.description: Token-aware locking script for the vault NFT and BCH.

scripts.effectiveSpentToday: <vaultCommitment> <8> OP_SPLIT OP_BIN2NUM <locktime> <86400> OP_DIV OP_NUMEQUAL OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM OP_MUL
scripts.newSpentToday: <vaultCommitment> <8> OP_SPLIT OP_BIN2NUM <locktime> <86400> OP_DIV OP_NUMEQUAL OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM OP_MUL <amountSatoshis> OP_ADD
scripts.newCommitment: <vaultCommitment> <8> OP_SPLIT OP_BIN2NUM <locktime> <86400> OP_DIV OP_NUMEQUAL OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM OP_MUL <amountSatoshis> OP_ADD <8> OP_NUM2BIN <locktime> <86400> OP_DIV <8> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT
scripts.remainingToday: <dailyLimitSatoshis> <vaultCommitment> <8> OP_SPLIT OP_BIN2NUM <locktime> <86400> OP_DIV OP_NUMEQUAL OP_SWAP OP_BIN2NUM OP_MUL OP_SUB

spenderKey.name: Spender key
spenderKey.description: The vault owner key or agent key.

agentPublicKey.name: Agent public key
agentPublicKey.description: Vault parameter: the agent, or 33 zero bytes for none.

rescuePublicKey.name: Rescue public key
rescuePublicKey.description: Vault parameter: the rescue co-signer, or 33 zero bytes.

dailyLimitSatoshis.name: Daily limit
dailyLimitSatoshis.description: Vault parameter: most satoshis per UTC day.

allowlistEnabled.name: Allowlist on
allowlistEnabled.description: Vault parameter: 1 if payments are limited to the allowlist, else 0.

allowedPkh1.name: Allowed payee 1
allowedPkh1.description: Vault parameter: P2PKH key hash (20 bytes), zeros if unused.

allowedPkh2.name: Allowed payee 2
allowedPkh2.description: Vault parameter: P2PKH key hash (20 bytes), zeros if unused.

allowedPkh3.name: Allowed payee 3
allowedPkh3.description: Vault parameter: P2PKH key hash (20 bytes), zeros if unused.

allowedPkh4.name: Allowed payee 4
allowedPkh4.description: Vault parameter: P2PKH key hash (20 bytes), zeros if unused.

allowedPkh5.name: Allowed payee 5
allowedPkh5.description: Vault parameter: P2PKH key hash (20 bytes), zeros if unused.

vaultCategory.name: Vault NFT
vaultCategory.description: Token category of the vault state NFT (display order).

vaultCommitment.name: Vault state
vaultCommitment.description: The state NFT commitment: spentToday (8 bytes LE) then dayMarker (8 bytes LE).

payeeLockingScript.name: Pay to
payeeLockingScript.description: Payee locking script (P2PKH if the allowlist is on).

locktime.name: Payment time
locktime.description: Unix time for the transaction locktime, a few hours in the past so nodes accept it. Its UTC day is the day the limit counts against.

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Network fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis paid to miners. A payment may take at most 1,000 from the vault.

topUpSatoshis.name: Top-up
topUpSatoshis.description: Satoshis to add to the vault.

returnLockingScript.name: Your address
returnLockingScript.description: Token-aware locking script for the vault NFT and BCH.
